Name: (English and Chinese) Custom Warps For Stardew Valley Expanded (Without IFR2 and Grandpa's Farm)
Author: AzuraQamar
Description:
zh.json is the Chinse Translation.
Because I didn't download IFR2 and Grandpa's Farm, I didn't make warps to their places.
warps.json is to: steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\CJBCheatsMenu\assets
zh.json is to: steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\CJBCheatsMenu\i18n
I added some new update places and quest warps.
(Reference: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5753)

!!!ATTENTION!!!
If you play this game for the first time, better not use this to replace.

01/14/2021 Edit
If you are a Chinese user, just put wrap.json into asset folder and zh.json into i18n folder at the same time or it doesn't work.
